column1: # Bilibin McCoy palace and grounds: pre-Kolima judgments, admissions of guilt, reward choices, and room inspections.

column3: A silk negligee rests\nhere.{page_break}{actor_name:1}!\nLeave that alone!{end_wait}

A list called Sweetie's
Gifts. Lord McCoy has
written down every present{page_break}for his wife. There are
pages of them.{end_wait}
The well looks dry. No\nwonder no one's using it.{end_wait}
Where've you been? I sent\nword hours ago.{end_wait}
Well? Have yeh made up yer\nminds?{end_wait}
Come on, {actor_name:1}. We said\nwe'd help them. We're not\nbacking out now, are we?{end_now}
If {actor_name:1}'s going into\nthat forest, I'm going too.{end_wait}
{actor_name:1}, was it? I'm sorry\nthe lord turned yeh away.{end_wait}
Oh... it's you.{end_wait}
That's not what the\nwitnesses say. You were\nseen near the forest.{end_wait}
That's enough. You're\ncoming with us. Lord McCoy\nwants answers.{end_wait}
We've brought the young\nwarriors, milord.{end_wait}
You've my thanks. Truly.{end_wait}
Nae need tae hide it. My\nmen told me what yeh did\nfor Kolima.{end_wait}
I worried yeh would leave\nBilibin without coming\nback. I wanted tae thank{page_break}yeh myself.{end_wait}
Lord McCoy asked us to\nbring {actor_name:1} and the\nothers here. Milord has{page_break}prepared a reward.{end_wait}
You may choose one item\nfrom these four chests.\nOnly one, mind you.{end_wait}
Don't leave before choosing\nyour reward. The lord\ninsisted.{end_wait}
You're welcome in this\npalace whenever yeh return.{end_wait}
They went where our own men\nwouldnae go. They deserve a\nproper reward.{end_wait}
Choose whichever chest yeh\nlike. The lord has put\nsomething in each.{end_wait}
Of course, yeh might get an\nitem yeh have nae use for.\nThat's the risk.{end_wait}
{protagonist_name} opened the\nchest.{page_break}It was\nempty.{end_wait}
The chest is locked tight.{end_wait}
I thought you were too\nyoung for a job like that.\nI was wrong, and I owe yeh{page_break}an apology.{end_wait}
Yeh did a fine job. I wish\nI could say I'd have been\nas brave.{end_wait}
Could I ever be as brave as\nyou were?{end_now}
I was afraid to go near\nKolima. You went anyway.\nI'll remember that.{end_wait}
There's one thing I dinnae\nunderstand. How did yeh get\npast the barricade without{page_break}the key?{end_wait}
Yeh shouldn't have needed\nto do our work. Sometimes\nit's the young who shame us{page_break}into acting.{end_wait}
I'll train until I can help\nsomeone the way {actor_name:1}\ndid.{end_wait}
People here will remember\nwhat yeh did for Kolima\nlong after you're gone.{end_wait}
Aaaah!{end_wait}
